name: Iridescent Spindle (Ioun Stone)
body:
Aura strong varied; CL 12th; Slot —; Price 18,000 gp; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

This stone sustains the wearer without air.

Cracked: This stone grants a +4 competence bonus on Constitution checks to hold your breath. Price: 500 gp.

Flawed: This stone sustains the wearer without air, but he is always staggered. Price: 12,000 gp.

See Inferior Ioun Stones for details on cracked and flawed variant stones.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Special creator must be 12th level; Cost 9,000 gp.
